explication: Streak is a private, on-device habit tracker. Its documented user journey is to create and schedule habits, log progress, then review streaks and statistics; the README also describes focus sessions, personalization, reminders, imports and backups. The supplied tree and excerpts chiefly expose Android widget/focus integrations, iOS widget payloads and desktop launchers—not the main Flutter feature implementation or its storage layer. Those documented capabilities are included without guessed source paths; native relationships are limited to those supported by excerpts or the source index.
